svg.title: Managed Prompt: instructions you change in Logfire, not in code
svg.desc: The prompt lives in Logfire as the managed variable prompt__support_agent, with labels such as production and staging. At the start of each run, ManagedPrompt resolves it in the wrap_run hook and uses the value as the run's instructions, which the model receives. The resolved label and version are set as baggage, so the agent run span and its children record which prompt produced them, and those traces go back to Logfire.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
